sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.carrier,
    co.name AS destination_country,
    s.id AS shipment_id,
    s.delivered_at,
    (CAST(s.delivered_at AS date) - CAST(s.shipped_at AS date)) AS transit_days
  FROM shipments s
  JOIN fulfillments f ON f.id = s.fulfillment_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = f.order_id
  JOIN addresses a ON a.id = o.shipping_address_id
  JOIN countries co ON co.id = a.country_id
  WHERE s.carrier IN ('Landfall Freight','Lowlands Express')
    AND s.shipped_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
    AND s.shipped_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
),
carrier_totals AS (
  SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS carrier_shipments
  FROM base
  GROUP BY carrier
),
country_stats AS (
  SELECT
    carrier,
    destination_country,
    COUNT(*) AS shipments_shipped,
    AVG(transit_days) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AS avg_transit_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND transit_days <= 3) AS within_3_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY carrier, destination_country
)
SELECT
  cs.carrier,
  cs.destination_country,
  cs.shipments_shipped,
  ROUND(cs.avg_transit_days, 2) AS avg_transit_days,
  ROUND(100.0 * cs.within_3_count / cs.shipments_shipped, 1) AS pct_within_3_days,
  ROUND(100.0 * cs.shipments_shipped / ct.carrier_shipments, 1) AS share_of_carrier_shipments_pct
FROM country_stats cs
JOIN carrier_totals ct ON ct.carrier = cs.carrier
WHERE cs.shipments_shipped >= 15
ORDER BY cs.carrier ASC, cs.shipments_shipped DESC, cs.destination_country ASC
note: pct_within_3_days is computed as (delivered shipments with transit_days<=3) / all shipments_shipped for that carrier+country (undelivered shipments count as not-within-3-days); avg_transit_days is averaged over delivered shipments only, per the given transit_days definition. share_of_carrier_shipments_pct uses the carrier's full-year total across all countries (not just those meeting the 15-shipment threshold) as the denominator.
